releaseNotes: V897 fixes the multi-client Connect reproduction where the VPN instance completed an 8-port master REST identity scan and logged no-engineering-remap-required, but WarmupOnceAsync still launched the full P1→P8 serial identity/selector sequence seconds later.

A connection-generation-scoped REST trust latch now allows WarmupOnceAsync to skip the serial startup identity sweep only when every REST-reported device is independently reusable and no persisted mapping/configuration evidence contradicts the authoritative REST VID/DID.

Unknown, partial, stale or changed identity evidence remains fail-closed and uses the unchanged sequential startup identification path. No new PDO writer, transport path or polling scheduler was introduced.

en: Skip redundant P1→P8 serial startup identity/selector work when the current connection's master REST identity is fully trusted and requires no engineering remap.
REST trust is connection-generation scoped and fails closed on stale, partial, contradictory or changed identity evidence.
Existing transport, polling, ISDU exchange and PdoOutputCoordinator write ownership remain unchanged.
ko: 현재 연결의 Master REST identity가 완전히 신뢰 가능하고 engineering remap이 불필요한 경우 중복 P1→P8 serial startup identity/selector 작업을 건너뜁니다.
REST trust는 connection generation 단위로 제한되며 stale/partial/contradictory/device-changed 근거가 있으면 기존 fail-safe startup sequence를 그대로 실행합니다.
기존 transport, polling, ISDU exchange 및 PdoOutputCoordinator write ownership 구조는 변경하지 않았습니다.
ja: 現在の接続で Master REST identity が完全に信頼でき engineering remap が不要な場合、重複する P1→P8 serial startup identity/selector をスキップします。
REST trust は connection generation 単位で、stale/partial/矛盾/デバイス変更時は既存 fail-safe startup sequence を維持します。
既存 transport、polling、ISDU exchange、PdoOutputCoordinator の write ownership は変更していません。
zh-CN: 当当前连接的 Master REST identity 完全可信且无需 engineering remap 时，跳过重复的 P1→P8 serial startup identity/selector 流程。
REST trust 仅在当前 connection generation 内有效；遇到 stale、partial、冲突或设备变化时继续执行原有 fail-safe startup sequence。
现有 transport、polling、ISDU exchange 与 PdoOutputCoordinator 写入所有权保持不变。
de: Der redundante serielle P1→P8 Startup-Identity/Selector-Lauf wird übersprungen, wenn die Master-REST-Identity der aktuellen Verbindung vollständig vertrauenswürdig ist und kein Engineering-Remap benötigt wird.
REST-Trust ist auf die Connection-Generation begrenzt und fällt bei veralteten, partiellen, widersprüchlichen oder geänderten Identitäten sicher auf den bestehenden Startup-Pfad zurück.
Transport, Polling, ISDU-Exchange und die Write-Ownership des PdoOutputCoordinator bleiben unverändert.
es: Se omite el barrido serial P1→P8 de identity/selector de arranque cuando la identidad Master REST de la conexión actual es totalmente confiable y no requiere engineering remap.
La confianza REST está limitada a la generation de conexión y ante evidencia stale, parcial, contradictoria o de cambio de dispositivo se conserva la secuencia fail-safe existente.
No se modifican transport, polling, ISDU exchange ni la propiedad de escritura de PdoOutputCoordinator.
